title: More Weight
sentences: In September 1692, Giles Corey was crushed to death under heavy stones.
Legend says his last words were a demand for more weight.
He was an old farmer, accused of witchcraft just like his wife, Martha.
Corey refused to enter a plea, so the court could not try him.
Under English law, that meant pressing.
Judge Samuel Sewall wrote that he was pressed to death for standing mute.
Three days later, Martha was hanged.
